hooks.name: hexperiment-check-on-save
hooks.description: Runs the fast Hexperiment check on the app that owns a Python file the agent saved. The run first clears the app's verdict, and a fast run is never APPROVED, so a saved change replaces an earlier APPROVED.

hooks.name: hexperiment-check-on-stop
hooks.description: When the agent ends its turn, names the apps it changed in this session that are not APPROVED and tells it to run the full audit or to say plainly that the work is not done. Exits 1 only then; Kiro gives the agent the message of a Stop hook that exits 1.
